data.claim: Contemporaneous reporting attributes to Garden City police the identification of Alberto Rincon as the suspect in the May 4 and July 1 robbery investigations and reports his July 4 arrest after a pursuit.
data.notes: No native Garden City PD release, Finney County charging instrument, docket, or judgment was captured. The listed arrest/requested charges must not be treated as convictions.
